description: The journal page now shows this day: once when the page has loaded, and again each time the user moves it to another day, a new journal day begins at 2:00, or the shown day can no longer be written. A view about one day follows it.

day.description: The shown day's date, YYYY-MM-DD, on the device's own calendar, as a journal day dates itself.

writable.description: Whether the shown day can still be written: today's page, also past midnight until the journal's day ends at 2:00. When it is absent, only the day whose date is today counts as writable.
